name: argus
description: Continuous security and dependency monitoring for code repositories

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b apps/server/tsconfig.build.json && npm run typecheck -w @argus/server && npm run typecheck -w @argus/web && npm run typecheck -w @argus/e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently -n build,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput apps/server/tsconfig.build.json" "npm run dev -w @argus/server" "npm run dev -w @argus/web"
